,subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the Asian martial artist in <Picture 1>, preserving his weathered face, intense eyes, gray-white topknot, thick gray beard, dusty off-white wrap robe, dark worn outer garment, and layered cloth belt.
<Subject 2> is the dusty rubble environment referenced from <Picture 1>, with coarse stone fragments, airborne earth, weathered timber, and pale daylight.

summary:
[reference generation] A six-second cinematic martial-arts video shows <Subject 1> performing one explosive “亢龙有悔” palm strike in <Subject 2>. He gathers internal energy into one white dragon, drives both palms forward simultaneously, and shatters a collapsing stone slab ahead. One continuous shot captures preparation, release, impact, and moving aftermath.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the referenced identity, facial features, hairstyle, beard, costume layers, fabric textures, and dirt marks throughout the newly staged action.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - retain the reference’s dusty rubble, earthy palette, and daylight; extend the environment into an open ruined courtyard with a collapsing stone slab eight meters ahead.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic cinematic wuxia with tactile fabric, natural skin detail, pale daylight, and warm airborne dust. Maintain readable anatomy and one continuous physical action.

[Shot 1] A slightly low, full-body three-quarter view establishes <Subject 1> on the left of the frame in <Subject 2>. His face, gray-white topknot, beard, layered robes, and cloth belt match the reference. His forward attack direction runs diagonally toward the right background, where a heavy stone slab is beginning to topple toward him. The camera stays on this same side of the attack axis, slowly dollying backward to keep his feet, both hands, and the distant slab visible.

From 00:00.000 to 00:01.100, he starts upright with relaxed arms at his sides and no visible energy. One foot slides sideways half a step. He bends both knees, sinks his hips, and draws both hands past his waist into his lower abdomen. His torso remains upright. Gravel crunches beneath his planted feet; white energy begins rising from his soles along his legs.

From 00:01.100 to 00:02.450, both hands rise along his centerline to his chest, palms facing each other, elbows visibly bent and close to his ribs. Behind him, one translucent white dragon forms in strict order: coiled body, rising neck, then head above and behind his shoulder. The dragon remains attached to his gathering energy.

From 00:02.450 to 00:03.400, he pulls both hands slightly closer to his chest. His elbows remain bent approximately ninety degrees. The dragon coils tighter, loose grit draws inward, and his robe hems lift. He suddenly raises his gaze toward the slab; his eyes briefly glow cold white while his hands remain retracted.

From 00:03.400 to 00:03.650, force travels from his grounded feet through his hips, back, stabilized shoulders, advancing elbows, and extending forearms. Both palms shoot forward simultaneously within 0.25 seconds and stop sharply. His left hand finishes at forehead height, fingers upward; his right hand finishes near waist height, fingers explicitly downward. Both palms face forward, both arms extend equally, and neither elbow hyperextends.

From 00:03.650 to 00:04.900, energy erupts from both palms only after their forward movement begins. The streams merge into a bright central core and a thick shock ring. The same dragon uncoils, its head passing through the ring before its body follows. It strikes and pierces the slab; the stone fractures only upon contact. A ground fissure races outward along the attack line, throwing debris to both sides.

From 00:04.900 to 00:06.000, the opened passage becomes visible. He remains planted, slightly leaning forward, holding the left-high, right-low palm position. He neither retracts his hands nor strikes again. The dragon dissipates inside the distant debris burst. Falling fragments, flowing dust, beard strands, and robe hems remain moving in the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Dry wind, distant stone grinding, gravel underfoot, and cloth movement. A tightening low energy hum accompanies gathering, followed by a sharp palm-release crack, a rushing dragon-like air roar, stone impact, and falling debris. No dialogue.
